ordered_steps.title: Audit translator schema drift before removing legacy parser shim
ordered_steps.summary: Audit the translator schema drift and remove the legacy parser shim that currently masks schema drift in local smoke runs.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Schema audit report and legacy shim removal patch.

ordered_steps.title: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures
ordered_steps.summary: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures so the plan contract catches ordering regressions with the new step ids.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated fixtures and passing plan_contract tests.

ordered_steps.title: Enable translated release-plan dashboard summary behind kill switch
ordered_steps.summary: Enable the dashboard summary behind a kill switch after schema is stable and fixtures are in place.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Dashboard summary enabled behind kill switch with canary coverage.

ordered_steps.title: Update operator runbook and launch checklist
ordered_steps.summary: Update the operator runbook and launch checklist after the summary path is proven in canary.

dependency_notes.reason: Dashboard summary consumes the step-id schema produced by the translator; schema must be audited and stable first.
Dashboard must not ship until dependency-graph fixtures reflect the new schema so plan contract catches ordering regressions.
Runbook and launch checklist only stabilize after the summary path is proven in canary and rollout/rollback shape is known.

primary_risk.statement: If the dashboard summary ships before schema audit and fixture backfill, it will render incorrect or stale step ordering to users because the legacy parser shim masks schema drift.
mitigations: Keep dashboard behind kill switch until schema audit (RN-101) and fixture backfill (RN-102) are complete.
Run canary-only coverage on dashboard summary before full rollout.
Monitor plan_contract test results to catch ordering regressions early.

assumption_ledger.topic: Kill switch implementation exists and is tested.
assumption_ledger.note: No evidence in repo inventory that a kill switch mechanism for the dashboard summary already exists or has been tested.
Release notes assume a canary environment exists for proving the summary path; no repo evidence confirms this.
